name: Delta Kardia
source:
The Heart of the Adventurer, the Delta Kardia, has chosen a new vessel. Unlock its immense power and bring in a new age! Rekindle your relationships with two old friends while you attend Leyfinder's College for Prospecting Adventurers, and do you best to adjust to such a modern yet fantasy rooted world. 

[From [url=https://hyponova.itch.io/delta-kardia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冒险家之心号Delta Kardia选择了一艘新船。释放其巨大力量，开创新时代！在Leyfinder's College for Prospecting Adventurers上学期间，与两位老朋友重新建立关系，并尽力适应这样一个现代而又植根于幻想的世界。

[来自[url=https://hyponova.itch.io/delta-kardia]Itch.io[/url]]
